title: G4CE's VanillaPlus
description: Vanilla+ Experience build on top of FabricOptiPlus
body:
# G4CE's Vanilla+
Vanilla+ has been interpreted by many... but i haven't done it yet... BUT NOW I DID
## Overview
G4CE's Vanilla+ is a vanilla+ modpack that doesn't stray too far from vanilla Minecraft but is still open to interpretation with the intent to add more mods on top of the modpack. The modpack itself is built on top of G4CE's FabricOptiPlus. The main goal of this modpack is to create a whole bunch of QOL additions to Vanilla Minecraft
## Main Features:
- Extensive accessories
- Fuzs's game mechanics addition
- Serilum's game mechanics addition
- Better Mending
- Elytra Mechanics
- Horse Mechanics
- Harvest with ease
- Fire Mechanics(?)
- Villager Trading QOL
